visual.general_description: Three side-by-side color skin photographs labeled "A : 0 min", "B : 5 Mins" and "C : 30 mins", each with a hand-drawn dark circle on the skin.
visual.detailed_description: Three adjacent color photographs separated by thin white gaps: a wide close-up on the left, a narrow portrait-oriented view of an arm in the middle and a wide close-up on the right. Each has a hand-drawn dark circle on the skin and a white overlay label at the lower right. Left: Inside the circle, right of center, there is an oval, glossy, amber-tinted area with a bright white highlight and a few tiny bright specks around it. Middle: A hand-drawn dark circle is on the skin of the arm. A small dark dot is near the center of the circle; no other distinct mark is clearly seen inside it. Right: At the center of the circle there is a small irregular dark red to dark brown spot with a few fine radiating lines; a small dark dot is visible at the left of the circle.

panels.general_description: Close-up skin photograph with a hand-drawn circle enclosing a small glossy oval area, labeled "A : 0 min".

Inside the circle, right of center, there is an oval, glossy, amber-tinted area with a bright white highlight and a few tiny bright specks around it. A small dark dot is visible left of center inside the circle. White overlay text at the lower right reads "A : 0 min".
